0.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_HANDMAID00476_000_000
0.description: Will you be joining us for this year's Little Ladies' Day celebration? The main event is a special performance by the Songbirds, and your attendance would make it all the more entertaining.

1.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_SYSTEM_000_001
1.description: In order to participate in the FATE “Color My World,” you must first progress through the quest “A Colorful Affair.”

2.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_HANDMAID00476_000_010
2.description: Ready to join the Songbirds' flock of fans, are we? Or perhaps, there is something you wish to know before attending the show?

7.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_SYSTEM_100_020
7.description: In order to participate in the FATE “Color My World,” you must be a Disciple of War or Magic.

8.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_HANDMAID00476_000_020
8.description: Very well, I will ready your garments at once. Have you decided which color you wish to wear?

9.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_Q2_000_000
9.description: Select the color of your Songbird ensemble.

14.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_CONFIRM_000_001
14.description: A fan of Narumi I see. Then I shall prepare your yellow ensemble?

15.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_CONFIRM_000_002
15.description: A fan of Ulala I see. Then I shall prepare your red ensemble?

16.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_CONFIRM_000_003
16.description: A fan of Masha Mhakaracca I see. Then I shall prepare your blue ensemble?

17.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_HANDMAID00476_000_021
17.description: Here are your clothes and illuminations. I do hope you enjoy the performance.

18.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_SYSTEM_100_021
18.description: The status effect granted to you by the royal handmaiden can be removed at any time by using the special action Curtain Call.

19.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_SYSTEM_200_021
19.description: Should you accidentally remove this effect, speak with the royal handmaiden once more to rejoin the Songbirds' fans.

21.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_A3_000_001
21.description: How can I show my support for the Songbirds?

23.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_A3_000_003
23.description: What can you tell me about the show?

25.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_HANDMAID00476_000_030
25.description: When the Songbirds are ready to take the stage, speak with me and I will ready your garments.

26.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_HANDMAID00476_000_031
26.description: And be certain to keep your illuminations at the ready. The girls are always overjoyed to see fans cheer for them using their signature colors.

27.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_HANDMAID00476_000_032
27.description: With your help, this will be a performance none shall soon forget.

28.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_SYSTEM_000_033
28.description: In order to participate in the FATE “Color My World,” you must first speak with the royal handmaiden on Emerald Avenue and prepare yourself to join the Songbirds' crowd of fans.

29.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_SYSTEM_000_034
29.description: Upon joining the FATE, you will be given three special actions: Cheer On, Cheer Wave, and Cheer Jump. Each action uses a different colored set of illuminated rods to cheer for the Songbirds.

30.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_SYSTEM_000_035
30.description: Bear in mind each Songbird is especially receptive to fans who cheer using their signature color.

31.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_HANDMAID00476_000_040
31.description: As way of thanks to those who come to join in our merrymaking, we are handing out certificates of collaboration.

32.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_HANDMAID00476_000_041
32.description: Speak with the royal servant and you can exchange them for a number of wondrous goods. If you lack the requisite number of certificates, I would encourage you to attend another performance to receive more.

33.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_SYSTEM_000_042
33.description: Certificates of collaboration can be obtained by participating in the FATE “Color My World” on Emerald Avenue.

34.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_HANDMAID00476_000_050
34.description: The Songbirds will be performing several times throughout the day adhering to a strict schedule, so be certain not to be late.

35.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_HANDMAID00476_000_051
35.description: Your celebratory garments and illuminations are presently in our keeping, but when you have need of them, come and speak with me. I will be more than happy to retrieve them for you.

36.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_HANDMAID00476_000_052
36.description: As you have three sets of garments to choose from, however, I will need to know which you wish to wear to the performance.

37.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_HANDMAID00476_000_053
37.description: And be certain to keep your illuminations at the ready. The girls are always overjoyed to see fans cheer for them using their signature colors.

38.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_SYSTEM_000_054
38.description: During this event, the FATE “Color My World” will appear on Emerald Avenue at the Steps of Nald.

39.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_SYSTEM_000_055
39.description: In order to participate in the FATE, you must first speak with the royal handmaiden on Emerald Avenue and prepare yourself to join the Songbirds' crowd of fans.

40.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_SYSTEM_000_056
40.description: Upon joining the FATE, you will be given three special actions: Cheer On, Cheer Wave, and Cheer Jump. Each action uses a different colored set of illuminated rods to cheer for the Songbirds. Bear in mind each Songbird is especially receptive to fans who cheer using their signature color.

41.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_SYSTEM_000_057
41.description: The status effect granted to you by the royal handmaiden can be removed at any time by leaving the area, or using the special action Curtain Call.

42.name: TEXT_FESPDY2018_00476_SYSTEM_000_058
42.description: Should you accidentally remove this effect, speak with the royal handmaiden once more to rejoin the Songbirds' fans.
